holdingTriage.name: Dayang Enterprise Holdings Berhad

watchlistTriage.name: Micron Technology
watchlistTriage.why: CXMT competitive DRAM claims do not establish HBM parity; verify yield/margins.
watchlistTriage.confirmation: Verify HBM paid customer demand and prices plus cash conversion after CXMT concerns; do not confuse 13 Oct chip weakness with cancelled orders.
watchlistTriage.invalidation: Meaningful HBM pricing or customer orders weaken, inventories rise, and earnings/FCF guidance is cut; failed chart support alone is an early alert, not fundamental proof.

watchlistTriage.name: Cheniere Energy
watchlistTriage.why: Contracted cargoes and DCF independent of short-term gas spot.
watchlistTriage.confirmation: Utilisation, contracts and distributable cash flow stay strong.
watchlistTriage.invalidation: Global LNG supply normalises faster than expected or cash generation weakens materially.

watchlistTriage.name: Credo Technology
watchlistTriage.why: AI interconnect customer financing, concentration and FCF.
watchlistTriage.confirmation: Revenue growth stays strong and cash remains healthy as hyperscaler demand broadens.
watchlistTriage.invalidation: Customer concentration rises further, growth slows sharply or margins fail to scale.

watchlistTriage.name: Grab Holdings
watchlistTriage.why: Turnaround cash generation versus Atome credit impairment and acquisition spending.
watchlistTriage.confirmation: Core Mobility/Deliveries margins hold, free cash flow remains positive, loan growth does not outrun credit quality and Atome produces credible returns on the cash committed.
watchlistTriage.invalidation: Credit costs/impairments accelerate, incentives re-expand materially, Atome economics disappoint or buybacks are overwhelmed by acquisition and lending cash needs.

watchlistTriage.name: BWX Technologies
watchlistTriage.why: Nuclear/defence contract cash, backlog delivery and entry valuation.
watchlistTriage.confirmation: 2026 FCF/EBITDA guidance is delivered, backlog converts cleanly and commercial nuclear/defence capacity expansion does not dilute returns.
watchlistTriage.invalidation: Backlog conversion slips, government programme timing materially delays cash flow or expansion/M&A causes a sustained return-on-capital deterioration.

watchlistTriage.name: Dell Technologies
watchlistTriage.why: AI server revenue may have thin margin and working capital costs.
watchlistTriage.confirmation: AI backlog converts into revenue, margin and cash rather than revenue alone.
watchlistTriage.invalidation: Backlog conversion slows or AI server margins deteriorate.

watchlistTriage.name: Constellation Energy
watchlistTriage.why: Contracted nuclear electricity; analyse economics beyond GW headline.
watchlistTriage.confirmation: Google-backed 3.59-GW agreements proceed, fleet upgrades stay on budget and contracted cash economics remain attractive.
watchlistTriage.invalidation: Contract economics weaken, fleet-upgrade capex overruns emerge or power-market/regulatory terms deteriorate.

watchlistTriage.name: Corteva
watchlistTriage.why: Crop-protection pure-play after Oct separation; old seed business excluded.
watchlistTriage.confirmation: Standalone crop-protection margins, free cash flow and new-product growth hold up without the seed business and separation costs normalise.
watchlistTriage.invalidation: Volume/pricing weakness persists, farm affordability hits demand or the standalone cost structure produces weaker-than-expected cash conversion.

watchlistTriage.name: Freeport-McMoRan
watchlistTriage.why: Copper grid demand vs China and mine restart risk.
watchlistTriage.confirmation: Grasberg recovery improves while copper stays structurally tight.
watchlistTriage.invalidation: Production recovery slips again or copper demand weakens materially.

watchlistTriage.name: Nutrien
watchlistTriage.why: Potash pricing/volumes and farm affordability; not equivalent to nitrogen.
watchlistTriage.confirmation: Potash volumes/pricing hold, capex discipline persists and retail/proprietary-product margins keep improving.
watchlistTriage.invalidation: Potash pricing rolls over, farmer affordability cuts application rates or cash returns weaken despite the lower capex plan.

watchlistTriage.name: Broadcom
watchlistTriage.why: ASIC real orders and cash collections vs financing circularity.
watchlistTriage.confirmation: Independently funded AI ASIC/networking orders produce cash margin without expanding risky supplier financing or contingent guarantees.
watchlistTriage.invalidation: Funding becomes necessary for incremental orders, expected customer cash receipts fail, or credit exposure erodes margins.

watchlistTriage.name: Cameco
watchlistTriage.why: Uranium offtakes and existing operating cash, not pure long-term speculation.
watchlistTriage.confirmation: Reclaim ~$90-92 first; $95-100 stronger repair
watchlistTriage.invalidation: Persistent lower lows or deterioration in contracting/mine/Westinghouse execution

watchlistTriage.name: CF Industries
watchlistTriage.why: North American nitrogen netback vs Henry Hub, energy/feedstock, volume and FCF.
watchlistTriage.confirmation: Nitrogen pricing stays constructive, plants run reliably, Blue Point execution stays controlled and free cash flow remains strong.
watchlistTriage.invalidation: Nitrogen supply loosens quickly, farm affordability destroys volumes, North American gas costs erase the cost advantage or Blue Point absorbs too much cash.

watchlistTriage.name: Alibaba Group
watchlistTriage.why: Alibaba is the strongest broad China-AI platform in the current stack because external Cloud revenue accelerated 45% and AI-related product revenue has grown triple digits for twelve straight quarters. The open question is whether that growth produces enough cloud profit and cash return to justify the capex while domestic commerce remains softer.
watchlistTriage.confirmation: Cloud growth stays strong, cloud margins/EBITA improve and AI capex produces measurable returns rather than only higher spend.
watchlistTriage.invalidation: AI-cloud growth slows before returns improve, capex/dilution rises faster than monetisation or domestic weakness drags consolidated cash generation.

watchlistTriage.name: GE Vernova
watchlistTriage.why: Funded gas-turbine/grid order conversion, gross margins and value.
watchlistTriage.confirmation: Backlog is independently funded and converts to shipped turbine/electrical revenue, rising margins and FCF, not just announced data-centre demand.
watchlistTriage.invalidation: Project payment delays/cancellations or turbine/electrification backlog/margin deterioration; high multiple compresses without earnings catch-up.

watchlistTriage.name: Vistra
watchlistTriage.why: Existing dispatchable generation, signed PPAs and funded counterparties remain exactly what the duration-constrained power regime rewards. Physical load evidence strengthened again, but entry discipline still matters.
watchlistTriage.confirmation: Sustain >$150; >$160 stronger
watchlistTriage.invalidation: Sustained <$132 or hedge/PPA/generation deterioration

watchlistTriage.name: Global X China Semiconductor ETF
watchlistTriage.why: This is a real diversified implementation vehicle, not an identifier error: Global X China Semiconductor ETF holds 21 China semiconductor names, including Cambricon, NAURA and newly listed CXMT. It reduces single-name execution risk, but the 0.68% ongoing charge and expensive constituent valuations still matter.
watchlistTriage.confirmation: Local semiconductor capex and qualification continue, major holdings convert policy support into earnings and the basket remains diversified enough to justify the fee.
watchlistTriage.invalidation: Localisation spending rolls over, constituent valuations detach from earnings or concentration rises enough that the ETF no longer meaningfully diversifies single-name risk.

watchlistTriage.name: Quanta Services
watchlistTriage.why: Grid project funding and construction cost overruns.
watchlistTriage.confirmation: Backlog/order/FCF strength plus funded customer demand
watchlistTriage.invalidation: Backlog/margin deterioration or capex cancellations

watchlistTriage.name: Eaton
watchlistTriage.why: Paid switchgear/backlog growth versus premium valuation.
watchlistTriage.confirmation: Electrical orders/backlog and margin/FCF improve, with customer-funded projects and current entry valuation confirmed.
watchlistTriage.invalidation: Electrical contract cancellations or margin/FCF decline, or the share price already reflects years of backlog growth.

watchlistTriage.name: CrowdStrike
watchlistTriage.why: Software valuation sensitive to long-term discount rates.
watchlistTriage.confirmation: ARR/bookings/renewals continue accelerating
watchlistTriage.invalidation: AI-security monetization fails to improve recurring economics

watchlistTriage.name: CXMT
watchlistTriage.why: CXMT is now directly listed on the STAR Market as 688825, removing the earlier investability ambiguity. The investment case is still cycle-sensitive: conventional DRAM profitability is benefiting from a strong memory market, while HBM qualification and yields remain the evidence required for a structural AI rerating.
watchlistTriage.confirmation: Fifth-generation DRAM ramps cleanly and credible HBM qualification/yield/customer evidence emerges
watchlistTriage.invalidation: DRAM pricing rolls over before HBM monetisation, capacity creates oversupply or advanced-memory execution stalls

watchlistTriage.name: Tenaga Nasional
watchlistTriage.why: Regulated grid rate recovery and data centre capex funding.
watchlistTriage.confirmation: >RM14.30 then ~RM14.90
watchlistTriage.invalidation: Sustained <RM13.00 or weakening regulated grid/DC economics

watchlistTriage.name: Baker Hughes
watchlistTriage.why: LNG/gas equipment, integration of Chart and cash leverage.
watchlistTriage.confirmation: IET orders/RPO and Chart integration convert to EBITDA/FCF
watchlistTriage.invalidation: Chart integration/leverage deterioration or LNG order slowdown

watchlistTriage.name: Scorpio Tankers
watchlistTriage.why: Product tanker day-rates, Gulf rerouting premium versus bunker costs.
watchlistTriage.confirmation: LR2/MR TCE remains elevated and longer charters lock rates
watchlistTriage.invalidation: Rapid Hormuz normalisation, product-spread collapse or tanker-rate mean reversion

watchlistTriage.name: Montage Technology
watchlistTriage.why: Montage is correctly listed as 688008.SH / 6809.HK. PCIe 6.x/CXL 3.x retimer qualification and CXL 3.2 controller trial production confirm technical progress; the next proof is material revenue conversion, not another product announcement.
watchlistTriage.confirmation: CXL/PCIe products move from validation/trial production into material server revenue while DDR5 interface demand and margins remain strong.
watchlistTriage.invalidation: CXL adoption slips, competitive standards compress margins or AI-server demand weakens materially

watchlistTriage.name: Zhongji Innolight
watchlistTriage.why: One of the strongest realised AI-infrastructure earnings profiles in the China universe and a global, not purely domestic, AI exposure. Geopolitical/customer concentration and recent rerating keep it selective.
watchlistTriage.confirmation: 800G/1.6T demand and hyperscaler orders remain strong with durable margins and cash conversion
watchlistTriage.invalidation: US-China restrictions disrupt customer access, hyperscaler demand normalises sharply or optical pricing/margins compress

watchlistTriage.name: Valero Energy
watchlistTriage.why: Diesel distillate cracks and refinery utilisation; compare input prices.
watchlistTriage.confirmation: Distillate/product cracks remain firm, inventories stay tight and refinery economics hold even as crude availability improves.
watchlistTriage.invalidation: Rapid product-inventory rebuild, crack-spread normalisation or sustained refinery-margin deterioration.

watchlistTriage.name: Marathon Petroleum
watchlistTriage.why: Refinery comparator vs VLO; capital returns and cash margins.
watchlistTriage.confirmation: Persistent diesel/gasoline cracks and throughput economics
watchlistTriage.invalidation: Rapid product-inventory rebuild or crack collapse

watchlistTriage.name: Phillips 66
watchlistTriage.why: Refining/midstream peer to test relative capital efficiency.
watchlistTriage.confirmation: High cracks plus logistics/marketing resilience
watchlistTriage.invalidation: Crack-spread normalisation and weaker throughput

watchlistTriage.name: nVent Electric
watchlistTriage.why: New promotion. nVent is adding its third liquid-cooling capacity expansion in three years, taking new space added above 400,000 sq ft. It offers narrower component-level exposure to the cooling/electrical bottleneck.
watchlistTriage.confirmation: Liquid-cooling capacity converts to orders, margins and FCF
watchlistTriage.invalidation: AI infrastructure slowdown or capacity/integration execution failure

watchlistTriage.name: Flex
watchlistTriage.why: Physical demand remains strong, but the new AI-financing theme raises the premium on named customers, deposits and cash conversion. Keep high research priority without treating all backlog equally. Sep 23 evening delta: stressed project finance and delayed pre-operating AI-infrastructure offerings increase the relative value of funded backlog, existing operating capacity and cash conversion; this improves selection quality but is not a reason to chase price.
watchlistTriage.confirmation: Named funded backlog + strong cash conversion
watchlistTriage.invalidation: Customer funding/backlog quality deteriorates

watchlistTriage.name: MN Holdings
watchlistTriage.why: Company-specific order-book proof keeps MN Holdings high in the Malaysia grid stack. Price and smaller-cap liquidity keep it below TENAGA/GEV/ETN/PWR.
watchlistTriage.invalidation: Sustained <RM3.20 or order-book/cash-conversion deterioration

watchlistTriage.name: SPDR Gold MiniShares
watchlistTriage.why: Gold diversifier conditioned on real yields, USD and gold sensitivity.
watchlistTriage.confirmation: Gold holds/reclaims trend while real yields stop rising
watchlistTriage.invalidation: Persistent real-yield/USD breakout with major gold support loss

watchlistTriage.name: Agnico Eagle Mines
watchlistTriage.why: Gold mining execution and FCF versus direct bullion exposure.
watchlistTriage.confirmation: Gold trend stabilises with real yields easing
watchlistTriage.invalidation: AISC/production deterioration or gold support loss

watchlistTriage.name: SLB
watchlistTriage.why: Services and thermal management: verified backlog cash proof.
watchlistTriage.confirmation: Kelvion integration + cooling growth + stable FCF
watchlistTriage.invalidation: Integration/leverage or service-cycle deterioration

watchlistTriage.name: Wheaton Precious Metals
watchlistTriage.why: Streaming economics vs miner and ETF duplication.
watchlistTriage.confirmation: Gold holds with easing real yields
watchlistTriage.invalidation: Precious-metal thesis break

watchlistTriage.name: FirstCash Holdings
watchlistTriage.why: Consumer-stress/credit mix and collateral loans; specific losses needed.
watchlistTriage.confirmation: Double-digit pawn receivable growth with FCF intact
watchlistTriage.invalidation: Receivable growth normalises or leverage/regulation worsens

watchlistTriage.name: Bunge Global
watchlistTriage.why: Grain basis/crush/working capital rather than farm-gate inflation.
watchlistTriage.confirmation: Viterra integration creates durable margin/cash-flow gains and the enlarged platform continues to raise through-cycle earnings.
watchlistTriage.invalidation: Crush/trading margins normalise sharply, integration costs overwhelm synergies or leverage/cash conversion deteriorates.

watchlistTriage.name: Valmont Industries
watchlistTriage.why: Irrigation versus farm capex affordability; utility structures counterweight.
watchlistTriage.confirmation: Irrigation/order recovery with better farmer margins
watchlistTriage.invalidation: Continued capex deferral

watchlistTriage.name: Salesforce
watchlistTriage.why: Mature SaaS lacks near-term differentiated thesis versus focused shortlist.
watchlistTriage.confirmation: Durable AI monetization and improving growth/FCF
watchlistTriage.invalidation: Growth remains mediocre relative to duration/valuation

watchlistTriage.name: NCR Voyix
watchlistTriage.why: Corporate restructure needs fresh company value/catalyst.
watchlistTriage.confirmation: Q3/Q4 FCF delivery + recurring growth
watchlistTriage.invalidation: FCF cut or leverage deterioration

watchlistTriage.name: Symbotic
watchlistTriage.why: Warehouse automation backlog/FCF unproven for core list.
watchlistTriage.confirmation: Deployment ROI + backlog + FCF
watchlistTriage.invalidation: Deployment or financing deterioration

watchlistTriage.name: Coinbase Global
watchlistTriage.why: Crypto-brokerage factor overlap absent a distinct issuer catalyst.
watchlistTriage.confirmation: Activity/USDC/FCF remain strong with lower real yields
watchlistTriage.invalidation: Liquidity deterioration

watchlistTriage.name: Bitcoin
watchlistTriage.why: Non-cash-flow liquidity asset; separate macro monitor from stock ranking.
watchlistTriage.confirmation: Improving flows with easing real yields
watchlistTriage.invalidation: Sustained breakdown with liquidity deterioration

watchlistTriage.name: Strategy
watchlistTriage.why: Leveraged BTC treasury structural risk, not cash-generating diversification.
watchlistTriage.confirmation: BTC strength with financing stress easing
watchlistTriage.invalidation: mNAV/financing stress

watchlistTriage.why: Pre-revenue nuclear: funding/technology risk exceeds current active capital relevance.
watchlistTriage.confirmation: Funded project + credible economics
watchlistTriage.invalidation: Continued dilution/financing weakness

ideaTriage.name: Geekplus
ideaTriage.why: For 2025, revenue rose 31.6% to RMB3.171bn, orders rose 31.7% to RMB4.137bn, gross margin improved to 35.5%, and adjusted net profit and operating cash flow turned positive. This clears the commercial-evidence bar, although durability still needs more reporting history.

ideaTriage.name: Cognex
ideaTriage.why: Q1 2026 revenue increased 24% year over year, adjusted EBITDA margin reached 26.9%, and the company introduced two new AI vision platforms. It is the cleanest picks-and-shovels robotics addition from the supplied ideas.

ideaTriage.name: Teradyne
ideaTriage.why: Q2 2026 revenue was $1.329bn, up 104% year over year, but Robotics contributed only $100m while Semiconductor Test contributed $1.122bn. Include as a crossover, not as a pure robotics holding.

ideaTriage.name: UBTECH Robotics
ideaTriage.why: 2025 revenue grew 53.3% to RMB2.001bn and humanoid products and services contributed RMB820.6m, but the company still lost RMB789.8m. This is a watch position, not a core robotics holding.

ideaTriage.name: Tesla
ideaTriage.why: Future-heavy duration sensitive; require delivered cash economics.

ideaTriage.name: UiPath
ideaTriage.why: Q1 FY2027 revenue grew 17% to $418m, ARR grew 12% to $1.901bn, GAAP operating income turned positive at $28m and adjusted free cash flow reached $130m. The operating evidence supports inclusion, but conviction stays below the physical-automation leaders.

ideaTriage.name: Cloudflare
ideaTriage.why: Q1 2026 revenue grew 34% to $639.8m and current RPO grew 34%, while Cloudflare Radar provides direct evidence that bot traffic is a material share of web requests. Include as an infrastructure watch, not as a bandwidth-volume proxy.

ideaTriage.name: SpaceX
ideaTriage.why: The IPO prospectus reported Q1 2026 consolidated revenue of $4.694bn and 10.3m Starlink subscribers; connectivity revenue grew 31.6% year over year, but subscriber ARPU fell 22.9%. The $135 IPO and subsequent $25bn bond issuance make capital structure and returns on invested capital central to the thesis.

ideaTriage.name: Alibaba Group
ideaTriage.why: Current setup is more attractive than pure model-layer names because falling model prices can expand cloud usage. Track AI-cloud growth versus capex and cloud EBITA; the thesis weakens if usage growth fails to translate into returns.

ideaTriage.name: CXMT
ideaTriage.why: Do not annualise shortage-era margins. The key rerating test is verified commercial HBM qualification rather than another strong conventional-DRAM quarter. Direct STAR Market access may be restricted for some investors.

ideaTriage.name: Montage Technology
ideaTriage.why: Clean bottleneck exposure, but recent rerating argues against chasing. Prefer pullbacks or evidence of faster CXL revenue conversion.

ideaTriage.why: One of the strongest realised AI-infrastructure earnings profiles in the China universe, but current momentum makes entry discipline important.
